basic_profile.bio: A self-proclaimed internet explorer, I have been navigating the depths of Reddit for a decade. Originally from Portland, Oregon, I work as a freelance graphic designer, which allows me flexible hours to engage in my online hobbies. I'm a huge fan of sci-fi, particularly anything related to space exploration and dystopian futures. I spend my evenings engrossed in video games, with EVE Online being my current obsession. Although single, I enjoy the company of my virtual crew. I typically browse Reddit late at night, fueled by coffee and curiosity.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in graphic design and a lifelong passion for technology, I have honed my skills through a combination of formal education and self-teaching. My interest in digital art and science fiction has led me to explore various online communities where I can discuss and expand my knowledge on these subjects.
